pr.body:
This isolated experiment corrects all 20 confirmed business targets to blocking YES independently of coverage, preserves before/after evidence, and invokes the same v4.2 verification entry in the existing required test job while retaining Java, HTTP and OpenSpec checks.

The initial revision intentionally selects the existing broken ledger fixture. Subsequent commits will record zero-test, missing-required-test and repaired positive controls. A failing Actions run is expected for negative controls and must remain a failed test check.

A separate Codex Agent B will issue an evidence-based simulated technical review. It is not a second GitHub identity or human approval. No main protection changes, bypasses, or protected merges are authorized or performed. Prior reports remain unchanged. This PR will remain unmerged.
pr.title: v4.2 closure: mandatory acceptance semantics and real CI controls
pr.head: validation/v42-closure
pr.display_title: v4.2 closure: mandatory acceptance semantics and real CI controls

candidate_workflow.content:
name: verify
on: [push, pull_request]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - run: javac --release 17 -d build-agent agent-evidence/Payment.java agent-evidence/PaymentTest.java
      - run: java -cp build-agent PaymentTest
      - run: python3 run_tests.py
      - run: python3 http-experiment/test_http.py
      - run: npm install --global @fission-ai/openspec@1.13.1
      - run: openspec validate --specs --strict --no-interactive
        env:
          OPENSPEC_TELEMETRY: '0'
      - run: openspec validate --archived --no-interactive
        env:
          OPENSPEC_TELEMETRY: '0'
      - name: v4.2 complete verification entry
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "V42_CHECKOUT_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          echo "V42_EVENT_SHA=$GITHUB_SHA"
          case_name=$(cat validation/v42/ci_case.txt)
          echo "V42_CASE=$case_name"
          set +e
          python3 validation/v42/verify.py --case "$case_name" --label "actions-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}"
          entry_exit=$?
          echo "V42_RESULT_BEGIN"
          cat "validation/v42/outputs/evidence/actions-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}/result.json" || exit 1
          echo "V42_RESULT_END"
          cat "validation/v42/outputs/evidence/actions-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}/"*.log
          echo "V42_ENTRY_EXIT=$entry_exit"
          exit "$entry_exit"
        env:
          PYTHONIOENCODING: utf-8
      - name: Preserve v4.2 actual execution evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: v42-evidence-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: validation/v42/outputs/evidence/
          if-no-files-found: error
